# 1700. Number of Students Unable to Eat Lunch

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def countStudents(self, students, sandwiches):
        """
        :type students: List[int]
        :type sandwiches: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        s1 = sum(students)
        s0 = len(students) - s1
        for x in sandwiches:
            if x == 0 and s0:
                s0 -= 1
            elif x == 1 and s1:
                s1 -= 1
            else:
                break
        return s0 + s1
```
